Requirements:
1 six-floor, each call decision.
2 eligible CabReq[i] OR (HallReq[i] AND NOT FullLoad).
3 If Enable FALSE or no eligible: HasTarget FALSE, TargetFloor CurrentFloor, NextDirection 0. Else eligible at CurrentFloor priority: HasTarget TRUE NextDirection 0.
4 For Direction=1 select nearest eligible floor above CurrentFloor; if none above, nearest below. For Direction=-1 mirrored. For Direction=0 nearest either side, equal ties lower.
5 HasTarget true selected; NextDirection sign TargetFloor-CurrentFloor; recompute every call. FullLoad masks hall only.

Code: anyEligible first. Then if Enable and any eligible:

 Direction=1: FOR i := CurrentFloor+1 TO 6: IF eligible then IF NOT found best:=i found true. This picks first above = nearest above. If none above, FOR i:=1 TO CurrentFloor-1: j:=CurrentFloor-i; if eligible and not found best j. This picks CurrentFloor-1 downward, i.e., nearest below. Correct.
 Direction=-1: first FOR i:=1 TO CurrentFloor-1 j=CurrentFloor-i, first eligible = nearest below. If none, FOR i=CurrentFloor+1 to 6 first eligible = nearest above. Correct.
 Direction=0: loops all i 1..6; d abs; if not found or d<bestDist or d=bestDist and i<best. Picks nearest; tie lower. Correct. CurrentFloor handled before so tie to current? If current eligible priority. If direction=0 and current not eligible no d=0. Fine.

In structured text, if start>end with positive step, no iteration. Good. CurrentFloor=6 Direction=-1: first FOR 1 TO 5 okay; fallback FOR 7 TO 6 no iteration. Good.

Tie Direction=0: if equal distance, lower. Code condition (d = bestDist) AND (i < best). Since loops ascending i, when equal, i > best always (for lower floor selected earlier); condition false, so keeps lower. If somehow best higher? Loop ascending, equal distance pairs lower then higher; lower comes first, then higher equal i > best so no replace. Correct. For odd? Fine.

anyEligible includes current and all. Good.
